thread: maddie: Quick design review — attached updated drilldown mock (figma: https://figma.redwood/app/req-drilldown-v3). Main asks: where should the Export/Copy actions live, what should the Correlation ID affordance look like, and any a11y nits on the stack trace list? eli: Love the compact header. My instinct: export is an infrequent action — hide under kebab (⋯) to reduce clutter. But copy-correlation should be 1-click visible because product teams use it in support flows. tim: Agree on kebab for full exports (CSV/JSON). For copy-correlation, prefer a tiny icon button next to the ID with a tooltip. Keep it touch-target 44px. If we make the whole ID selectable it conflicts with click-to-copy on mobile. jyoti: Accessibility concerns: icon-only buttons need accessible names. Proposed aria-label: "Copy correlation id". Also ensure keyboard focus order: ID -> Copy button -> More actions. Add visible focus ring (2px) and ensure color contrast >= 4.5:1 for the pill background. maddie: Good call. Proposed microcopy options: 1) "Copy ID" 2) "Copy correlation id" 3) "Copy request id" — which is clearer? Also thinking about inline success feedback: a transient tooltip "Copied!" vs in-row toast. eli: "Copy correlation id" is explicit for platform folks. Tooltip "Copied!" is fine — non-blocking. For analytics, fire an event on copy so we can measure frequency before promoting to top-level action. tim: Implementation note — we should debounce copy analytics to avoid spam if user clicks multiple times. Also we can reuse existing tooltip component. Sample HTML for a11y: ``` abc123 ``` and JS: attach aria-live region for "Copied" announcements for screen readers. tim: attach aria-live region for "Copied" announcements for screen readers. jyoti: +1. Ensure aria-live="polite" and add role="status" only when message appears. For keyboard, support Enter/Space on the button. Also consider making the correlation id a link to permalink (if available) so keyboard users can open in new tab. maddie: UX question: do we show the full correlation id or truncate with tooltip? Long IDs blow up layout. Option A: truncate to 8 chars + ellipsis, full on hover/tap. Option B: show full but allow horizontal scroll. Thoughts? eli: Truncate for list rows, full on drilldown. Clicking copy should copy full id regardless. Track support requests where people paste full id and it fails if truncated. tim: Truncate visually, add title attr for hover and a visible tooltip on focus. Mobile: tapping the ID should open drilldown. Copy icon stays separate for explicit copy. jyoti: If truncating, ensure screen readers still read full id (aria-label="correlation id: abc123..."). Otherwise SR users will only get truncated text. maddie: Noted. Final item: export placement — kebab vs per-row menu. I'll prototype kebab + an optional "quick export" toolbar action for power users. Will update figma and push a PR for the component. ux-bot: Reminder: design-review checklist due Friday — include keyboard walkthrough and contrast report. :spiral_calendar:
